units.source_text: 新馆正面朝南，庭院宽广，阳光直落在棋盘近处。

en.t: The front of the new hall faced south, the garden was broad, and sunlight fell straight down near the go board.

units.source_text: 等待启封黑145的过程，名人也歪起脑袋，紧锁双眉，直视着棋盘，显出一派严峻的神态。

en.t: While they waited for Black 145 to be unsealed, the Master also tilted his head, knit his brows tightly, and stared straight at the board, showing a stern expression.

units.source_text: 大竹七段大概已经看到胜利在望，落子也快了。

en.t: Otake 7-dan had probably already seen that victory was within reach, and his moves became quicker as well.
